target_claim: The connected classification theorem can be applied directly to the arbitrary compact one-manifold M introduced in the proof.
source_quote:
By [[Classification of Compact One-Manifolds]]:
Every [[Definition:Compact Topological Space|compact]] [[Definition:Connected Topological Space|connected]] one-[[Definition:Dimension (Topology)|dimensional]] manifold is [[Definition:Diffeomorphism|diffeomorphic]] to either a [[Definition:Circle|circle]] or a [[Definition:Closed Interval|closed interval]].
